name: Keytruda (Pembrolizumab)
description: Commercial FDA-Approved Pharmacopoeia Standard indicated for advanced metastatic melanoma, non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), head and neck squamous cell carcinoma, and classical Hodgkin lymphoma. Mechanistically, it operates as a humanized IgG4 monoclonal antibody that binds with exceptional affinity to the programmed cell death 1 (PD-1) receptor, blocking interaction with PD-L1/PD-L2 ligands to reactivate tumor-infiltrating cytotoxic T-lymphocytes. Clinical trials demonstrate high therapeutic efficacy with significant overall survival improvements and managed immune-related adverse events.

name: Vyom-Cosmic-HER2-Blocker-Beta-47095
target_protein: Human Epidermal Growth Factor Receptor 2 (HER2 Overexpressed)
description: Advanced In-Silico Pipeline Discovery engineered via harmonic dyadic field equations. Indicated for targeted management of HER2-positive metastatic breast carcinoma, refractory ovarian malignancies, and aggressive gastric adenocarcinomas requiring cellular proliferation arrest. Mechanistically, it deploys allosteric harmonic frequency modulation that radically disrupts receptor heterodimerization interfaces, suppresses extracellular domain cleavage, and permanently halts PI3K/AKT survival networks.

name: Vyom-Cosmic-BRAF-V600E-Core-12105
description: Advanced In-Silico Pipeline Discovery engineered via harmonic dyadic field equations. name: Osimertinib (Tagrisso)
description: Commercial FDA-Approved Pharmacopoeia Standard indicated as first-line therapy for metastatic NSCLC harboring EGFR exon 19 deletions or L858R mutations, alongside activity against T790M resistance mutations with robust central nervous system penetration. Mechanistically, it acts as an irreversible third-generation mutant-selective EGFR tyrosine kinase inhibitor, forming covalent bonds with the Cys797 residue to successfully overcome resistance while sparing wild-type receptors.

name: Trastuzumab (Herceptin)
description: Commercial FDA-Approved Pharmacopoeia Standard indicated for HER2-overexpressing metastatic breast cancer, adjuvant early breast cancer, and advanced gastric or gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma.
